title: Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge for LLM-Based Knowledge Graph QA
abstract: arXiv:2608.24824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for knowledge graph question answering (KGQA), but can fail to correctly ground answers in the underlying graph. Current approaches to LLM-based KGQA either rely on full semantic parsing into executable queries such as SPARQL, which is brittle in practice due to complex schemas or incompleteness of real-world KGs, or on LLM-reasoning and answer generation over KGs, which can be more robust but lacks formal guarantees. In this work, we study a complementary setting in which \emph{candidate} answers are generated by an LLM-based system and subsequently verified using lightweight symbolic constraints derived from the question. We introduce \emph{Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge (CES-PK)}, a problem formulation that focuses on eliminating invalid answers and providing symbolic support for valid ones without requiring construction of executable logical forms. translated_title: 部分知识下的约束实体选择用于基于LLM的知识图谱问答
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24824v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地用于知识图谱问答（KGQA），但在将答案正确锚定到底层图谱方面可能失败。当前基于LLM的KGQA方法要么依赖完全语义解析为可执行查询（如SPARQL），这在实践中因复杂模式或真实世界KG的不完整性而显得脆弱，要么依赖LLM推理和KG上的答案生成，这更稳健但缺乏形式保证。在这项工作中，我们研究了一个互补设置，其中候选答案由基于LLM的系统生成，随后使用从问题中提取的轻量级符号约束进行验证。我们引入了部分知识下的约束实体选择（CES-PK），这是一个问题表述，专注于消除无效答案并为有效答案提供符号支持，而无需构建可执行逻辑形式。为了处理不完整性...
tldr: 本文提出一种在部分知识下通过轻量级符号约束验证LLM生成的候选答案，以消除无效答案并提供符号支持的方法，无需完整语义解析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method to validate LLM-generated candidate answers using lightweight symbolic constraints under partial knowledge, eliminating invalid answers and providing symbolic support without full semantic parsing.
